_comment: Every line JARVIS is expected to say during the demo. Served at /api/phrases so the controller's buttons and scripts/warm-voice.sh cannot drift apart, and so warming the cache covers exactly what the demo will use. Keep them under about ten words — SPEC.md §31.
phrases: We are here for GDG Essentials!
_counts: Spoken answers to 'how many systems are online'. These must match core/server.js exactly, word for word — a digit where this says a word is a cache miss on every ask. core/test/phrases.test.js enforces that.
